name: Orion Minerals Limited
source: Orion Minerals Limited audited annual reports. FY2025 and FY2024 columns read from the ANNUAL REPORT 2025 (year ended 30 June 2025), consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, page 68, figures printed in A$ thousands and stored in absolute AUD; FY2026 column unchanged from the FY2026 annual report. FY2025 Operating Expenses 13,322 is employee expenses 2,553 plus exploration and evaluation costs expensed 6,435 plus other operational expenses 4,334. FY2025 Operating Profit -12,936 is the statement's Results from operating activities. FY2024 restated to the FY2025 comparative column: Operating Expenses 11,365 (employee 1,564 plus exploration 4,905 plus other operational 4,896), Operating Profit -10,984 and Net Finance Costs -1,845 (net finance INCOME for that year, so negative under this file's negative-is-income convention). The earlier FY2024 figures (12,069 operating expenses, -12,069 operating profit, 2,527 finance costs) came from the FY2024 report and did not reconcile to the printed Profit Before Tax of -7,944. The -7,944 to -15,355 movement in both years also carries non-operating items (FY2025 expense 696, FY2024 income 1,195) that the fixed label set has no row for. FY2024 Net Profit -7,944 is the group loss for the year, matching the attributable-loss split (non-controlling interest 2,555, owners 5,389) and Profit Before Tax less Income Tax of nil, and matching the -10.72% ROE already stored for that year. EPS is now stored in dollars per share in every period: the statements print basic loss per share of 0.18 cents (FY2025), 0.09 cents (FY2024) and 0.12 cents (FY2026), which is 0.0018, 0.0009 and 0.0012 AUD; the FY2026 cell previously held 0.12, the cents figure, against 0.0031 for FY2023, a 100x unit break inside one column set. Sources: https://www.orionminerals.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/20250930-ORN-ASX-JSE-2025-Annual-Report.pdf (page 68 of the report, PDF page 70) and the JSE SENS announcement of 17 September 2026 for the FY2026 per-share figures. Read 2026-10-19.
